definitions.slip: Recorded last-substep saturation flag, not independently measured outward sliding. Tick-average force and boundary capacity are not same-time substep measurements.
definitions.noGrip: No acquired joint; cannot infer grip-force failure. Short goal-line TDs may leave no viable pursuit interval.
